description: Get SpO2 summary for a date when available. Requires heartrate scope. Not medical advice.

date.description: Date as yyyy-MM-dd or today. ISO date-times are accepted and reduced to the written calendar day.

privacy_mode.description: Optional per-call privacy override. Defaults to FITBIT_PRIVACY_MODE or structured. raw returns upstream Fitbit JSON. summary removes GPS/map details.

name: fitbit_get_spo2_day
title: Fitbit Daily SpO2
